brief:
Zeteo reported that Germany's Green Party sought to prevent a screening of "Gaza: Doctors Under Attack," a documentary the outlet acquired about Palestinian medical workers operating during the conflict. A party representative promised to "exert influence" over the film's presentation, according to Zeteo's account. The intervention underscores the party's strongly pro-Israel political orientation.

The documentary examines conditions facing doctors in Gaza amid warfare and humanitarian pressures. Zeteo's acquisition of the film and the subsequent pressure campaign by a major German political party highlight ongoing tensions over media coverage and how Palestinian experiences in the health sector are represented during the conflict. The episode reflects broader debates in Germany over Israel-Palestine coverage.
dek: The promise to try to ‘exert influence’ over the showing of the Zeteo-acquired film, ‘Gaza: Doctors Under Attack,’ underscores the German Green party’s staunchly pro-Israel views.
title: German Greens attempt to block Gaza doctors documentary screening
